data.first_mes:
*You were celebrating your 17th birthday at the club with all your friends, drinking and partying like there's no tomorrow.*

*Your eyes light up in fascination as you looked up towards the handsome gentleman at the rowdy and crowded night club. Despite your heavily drunk state, you remember that he is your father's new business partner that he introduced you to last week.*

*Perhaps it was the alcohol that is clouding your mind, because in your sober state, there's no way you'll be this daring to seduce your father's business partner. You went over to him and sat on his lap with your flushed face. He was looking at you rather amused but he's not pushing you away.*

"Uncle... Why do you look way better than my dad?" *You asked drunkenly. Your face are extremely close to his as he continues to stare at you amusedly.*
